_comment: Synced by .github/workflows/labels.yml on merge. The sync creates and updates and never deletes. `claude: true` marks the labels the weekly upkeep run may add.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something isn't working

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: New feature or request

labels.name: documentation
labels.description: Improvements or additions to documentation

labels.name: question
labels.description: Further information is requested

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Good for newcomers: small, settled, checkable

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: Design settled, open to an outside contributor

labels.name: invalid
labels.description: This doesn't seem right

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on

labels.name: difficulty:easy
labels.description: One or two files, no background needed

labels.name: difficulty:medium
labels.description: Read a module end to end first

labels.name: difficulty:hard
labels.description: Crosses modules or needs the theory

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: Labelled by a maintainer or the weekly upkeep run

labels.name: claude-proposed
labels.description: Filed by the weekly upkeep run. Scope not yet confirmed

labels.name: upkeep-log
labels.description: The weekly upkeep run's log issue

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: Pull requests that update a dependency file

labels.name: research
labels.description: Part of the maintainer's research programme

labels.name: demo
labels.description: A demonstration or figure

labels.name: area:models
labels.description: Model types and structure: dynamics, observation, structure, types, agent

labels.name: area:inference
labels.description: Filtering backends: kalman, coupling, rxinfer

labels.name: area:ffg
labels.description: Forney factor graphs and message passing

labels.name: area:planning
labels.description: EFE, selection, enumeration, control and crossover

labels.name: area:warrantlib
labels.description: The warrantlib package under packages/warrantlib

labels.name: area:docs
labels.description: The docs site, README and docstrings

labels.name: area:examples
labels.description: Scripts and figures under examples/

labels.name: area:ci
labels.description: Workflows, hooks and tooling
